# Third-party notices

The included `assets/gpt2_first_block` contains the embedding tables and first
transformer block of OpenAI GPT-2, exported from the locally cached Hugging Face
GPT-2 model. The complete released QA-LLM-GF states also include GPT-2 weights.

- Model card: https://huggingface.co/openai-community/gpt2
- Upstream license: https://github.com/openai/gpt-2/blob/master/LICENSE
- License notice: `GPT2_LICENSE.txt` (ASCII apostrophe used in this copy).

Python dependencies retain their respective licenses. This notice does not
assign a license to the authors' QA-LLM-GF code, models or derived sample data.
Those release decisions remain pending; see `../LICENSE_PENDING.md`.
